_note: Rule values for Alpha Strike as data, not as code (CLAUDE.md working rule 1). These tables were hard-coded in js/as-battle.js until they were checked against the book; see docs/RULES-SOURCES.md for what is confirmed and what is not.
asOf: 2026-09 · Alpha Strike: Commander's Edition, 7th printing tables + errata v7.02
_source: Determining Critical Hits Table (AS:CE p. 50) and Motive Systems Damage Table (AS:CE p. 51), read against the official tables PDF (7th printing) and the effect texts against errata v7.02.

critTables._note: 2D6, one row per result. The effect texts follow errata v7.02 where it changed them - see the notes on mpHit and weaponHit below.
mech: Engine – +1 heat in the end phase if it fired, second hit destroys
Fire control – +2 to all attacks each
Weapon – all damage values −1 (1 → 0*, 0* → no attack)
MP – halve MV and TMM, rounding down, at least −2″ and −1
vehicle: Crew stunned – no movement, no attacks, counts as immobile
Fire control – +2 to all attacks each
Weapon – all damage values −1 (1 → 0*, 0* → no attack)
Crew killed – vehicle out of action
Engine – MV and damage halved, a second hit destroys
proto: Weapon – all damage values −1 (1 → 0*, 0* → no attack)
MP – halve MV and TMM, rounding down, at least −2″ and −1, stacks

critEffects._note: Errata v7.02 rewrote three of these. Kept here as prose so the rules page and the tracker cannot drift apart.
critEffects.engineMech: The 'Mech generates 1 heat point in the end phase if it made any weapon attack that turn. Separate from overheating and adds to it. A second engine hit destroys the unit.
critEffects.mpHit: Halves all Move ratings and TMM, rounding down. Each MP hit takes at least 2″ of MV and 1 TMM, down to a minimum of 0.
critEffects.weaponHit: All damage values, including those of special abilities that carry damage (AC, ARTX, FLK, HT, IF, LRM, SRM, TOR, TUR), are reduced by 1. A value of 1 becomes 0*, and 0* becomes no attack at that range.
critEffects.crewStunned: No movement and no attacks, and the vehicle counts as an immobile target, until the end of the following turn.

motiveTable._note: 2D6 plus the modifier for the unit's motive type, rolled on every hit against a vehicle - armour damage included.
rows: MV and TMM halved, rounding down, at least −2″ and −1

modifiers._note: Keyed by the movement code in the MV value: t tracked, n naval, s submersible, w wheeled, h hover, v VTOL, g WiGE.

abilityModifiers._note: NOT on the Motive Systems Damage Table itself. ARS is described in the special abilities section (AS:CE p. 77), which is not part of the free tables PDF - unconfirmed, see docs/RULES-SOURCES.md.
